mapper.insert: insert into app_user_token (user_id, token_id, user_agent, ip, expires_at) values (#{userId}, #{tokenId}, #{userAgent,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ip,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: select count(1) from app_user_token where token_id = #{jti} and revoked = 0 and expires_at > now()
mapper.update: update app_user_token set revoked = 1 where token_id = #{jti} and revoked = 0
